source: Schwartz WB, Brackett NC Jr, Cohen JJ. The response of extracellular hydrogen ion concentration to symptomatic hypercapnia. J Clin Invest 1965; 44(2):291-301.
claim: In a stable chronic hypercapnic patient (baseline PaCO2 55 mmHg, HCO3 30 mmol/L) breathing room air without an assistive device, arterial PaCO2 is maintained stably between 50 and 60 mmHg over 30 minutes without pathological hyperventilation.
failureReason: The benchmark patient lacks the ventilatory capacity to hold its setpoint.
